messages:
maria: Quick question — for the new internal routing we've observed 10-30% p99 latency regressions when the gateway does gRPC->JSON transcoding plus quota checks. Do we want routing/policy decisions lived in the edge gateway or in the runtime router? Thoughts?

devon: leaning runtime. Gateway transcoding adds CPU + sync calls. If runtime has route-heat and cached decisions it's much cheaper. :thinking: 

aj: runtime makes sense but it complicates multi-tenant quota enforcement. we rely on gateway for token-matching today. can runtime surface the same attributes? 

sophie: if we move policy into runtime we should move to a compact policy wire (protobuf) to avoid parsing cost. Example header we use today:
```
X-Customer-ID: 123
X-Route-Claim: model:16k;tier=dedicated
```
Transcoding today turns these into JSON which is heavier.

devon: +1 to protobuf header proto/encoded metadata. Also propose sampling telemetry for decision path (1% all requests, 100% for canary). 

maria: how would rollout UX look? console needs to show 'policy evaluated at gateway/runtime' as an attribute. Can we tag traces? 

sophie: yes, add a boolean tag `policy_location` in trace spans and a `policy_version`. console team: @Console Team can we add UI for that? 

Console Team: we can, add a new per-route column: policy_location and policy_version. We should also add an alert when policy mismatch >5% across regions. 

deploy-bot: deploy started for gateway/telemetry-sampling canary (canary=5 hosts) by @sre on branch feature/gateway-sample — see https://ci.company/1234

aj: for quotas: if runtime enforces, it needs synced counters. proposal: gateway keeps a local token bucket for fast rejects and forwards meter events to runtime for accounting. Anyone object? 

devon: sounds fine. document the failure modes: runtime down -> gateway falls back to permissive/deny depending on SLO. Prefer deny for security.

maria: ok action items: 1) Sophie proto header PR 2) Devon telemetry sampling + trace tags 3) Aj quota sync design doc 4) Console team UI column + alert. I'll open RFC in docs repo.

sophie: i'll start the header PR, pinging @devon for proto review. :thumbsup:
